q1.question: What is Loyali?
q1.answer: Loyali is a digital loyalty card platform that allows local businesses to create loyalty programs using Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. No app download required for customers - they simply scan a QR code to join and earn rewards.

q2.question: How long does it take to set up Loyali?
q2.answer: Loyali can be set up in under 5 minutes. Create your card, print your QR code, and start enrolling customers immediately. No hardware installation or technical training required.

q3.question: Do customers need to download an app?
q3.answer: No. Customers add your loyalty card directly to their Apple Wallet or Google Wallet by scanning a QR code. No app download, no login friction - just scan and earn.

q4.question: What types of businesses use Loyali?
q4.answer: Loyali is designed for physical stores including cafes, restaurants, bars, retail shops, salons, and other local businesses that want to increase customer retention and repeat visits.

q5.question: How much does Loyali cost?
q5.answer: Loyali offers two plans: Core (€9/month) with everything you need to launch loyalty, and Grow (€12/month) with push notification campaigns and advanced analytics. All plans include a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: This privacy policy explains how Loyali and the merchants who use Loyali ("we") collect, use, and protect your personal data when you join a loyalty program through our platform.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body:
When you join a merchant's loyalty program, that merchant is the data controller for your customer data. Loyali (operated by Loyalnes) acts as the data processor on the merchant's behalf, providing the technical platform.

For questions about how a specific merchant uses your data, contact the merchant directly.

data.title: Data we collect
data.body: We collect only the information you provide when joining: first name, last name (optional), email address, and phone number (optional). We also store loyalty activity (points earned, rewards redeemed, visit history) generated as you use the program.

purposes.title: How we use your data
purposes.body: Your data is used to: (1) issue and manage your digital loyalty card, including Apple Wallet and Google Pay passes; (2) track points, rewards, and program activity; (3) send transactional notifications related to your loyalty card; (4) provide aggregated, anonymized analytics to the merchant.

legal.title: Legal basis
legal.body: We process your data based on your explicit consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR), provided when you check the consent box on the join form. You can withdraw consent at any time.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.body: Your data is kept while your loyalty card is active and for up to 24 months of inactivity, after which it is anonymized or deleted unless legal obligations require longer retention.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under GDPR you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, or port your data, and to object to processing. To exercise these rights, contact the merchant or write to privacy@loyali.online.
